4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C ARMOURED VEHICLES NIGAM LIMITED (AVNL), VEHICLE FACTORY JABALPUR . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses are as follows:- a) Firm’s Specification should strictly adhere to VFJ Specification for the tendered item. In this regard, p articipating firm has to upload Annexure- ‘B’- Undertaking for Compliance with VFJ Specification. Further, a ny correspondence regarding to alter/amendment in Item specification will not be entertained. b) Delivery Schedule: The Delivery Schedule is as mentioned at Annexure ‘A’ - Additional Scope of Work attached with this GeM LTE bid should be strictly followed by the participating firms. c) The participating firms have to refer the Annexure-‘A’: Additional Scope of Work (attached with GeM Bid) for other Bid terms & conditions and Bid related documents to be submitted by firms. d) Arbitration Clause: All disputes & differences arising out of or in any way touching or concerning this agreement (except those for which specific provision has been made therein) shall be referred to Sole Arbi trator to be appointed by CMD/AVNL-Chennai with the mutual consent of the parties. The Arbitrator so app ointed shall be a Government Servant / Ex-Government Servant (with mutual consent) who had not dealt with matter to which this agreement relates and in course of his duties had not expressed views on all or a ny of the matter in dispute or differences. The Award of Sole Arbitrator shall be final and binding on the pa rties. The Venue of Arbitration shall be Jabalpur. e) The tender Enquiry (TE/RFP) is issued without any financial commitment at this stage. The Buyer reserv es the right to amend or modify any part of the TE at any stage. Such amendment/modifications to the TE, if any, shall be duly notified subsequently. Buyer reserves the right to withdraw the TE at any stage, shoul d it so become necessary. .
